# The same UPS late in the power cut: on battery and below
# battery.charge.low, so the driver adds LB. Written from the protocol
# docs; not recorded.
> VER
< Network UPS Tools upsd 2.8.2 - https://www.networkupstools.org/
> LIST UPS
< BEGIN LIST UPS
< UPS rack "Rack UPS"
< END LIST UPS
> LIST VAR rack
< BEGIN LIST VAR rack
< VAR rack battery.charge "18"
< VAR rack battery.charge.low "20"
< VAR rack battery.runtime "170"
< VAR rack battery.type "PbAc"
< VAR rack device.mfr "EATON"
< VAR rack device.model "5P 1550"
< VAR rack driver.name "usbhid-ups"
< VAR rack input.voltage "0.0"
< VAR rack input.voltage.nominal "230"
< VAR rack ups.load "25"
< VAR rack ups.realpower "270"
< VAR rack ups.realpower.nominal "1100"
< VAR rack ups.status "OB DISCHRG LB"
< END LIST VAR rack
